---
title: ""
# The visible title is deliberately empty -- the banner carries the design --
# but the <title> tag is the most heavily weighted thing on the most linked
# page of the site, so it says what the site is about rather than just who
# wrote it. `description-meta` sets the meta description without printing a
# subtitle above the listing.
#
# Quarto appends the site title, so this must not repeat the name, and
# `description-meta` has to be a plain string -- a block scalar is treated as
# markdown and lands in the meta tag wrapped in a <p>.
pagetitle: "Notes on AI, machine learning and software"
description-meta: "Essays and notes by Joe Halliwell on AI architecture and safety, machine learning, programming, and whatever else seems interesting at the time."
# Otherwise the listing lends the page one of the posts' images as its card.
image: /profile.jpg
listing:
  contents: posts
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed: true
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
---
